sections.Profile:
The "Wheel of Fortune" pinball machine, released by Stern Pinball in October 2007, is themed around the popular television game show. Designed by Dennis Nordman with artwork by Kevin O'Connor and Margaret Hudson, the machine features voiceovers from Pat Sajak and Charlie O'Donnell, adding authenticity and excitement to the gameplay.
